headlines.text: Flash back to 2021, when Minoru Suzuki announced their arrival in style, headlining their very first AEW appearance against Jon Moxley, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.18.
Back on this day in 2023, Samoa Joe vs. Jeff Hardy met in a Tournament Match, headlining the show on Rampage, rated 6.42.
Rewind to 2023, when Penta El Zero M vs. Jay Lethal met in a Tournament Match, kicking off the show on Rampage, rated 6.35.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2021, when it was a welcome sight as Dustin Rhodes returned to the ring after just over 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
On a Friday in 2023, back when The Young Bucks vs. 2.O crossed paths for the first time ever on Rampage, rated 5.97.
Back on this day in 2021, it was the first-ever encounter between Ruby Soho and Jamie Hayter on Dynamite, rated 4.63.
